shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat package.json tsconfig.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null

for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/*.js styles/globals.css; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version"
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; ls 02-guides | grep -i migrat; ls 02-guides/migrating 2>/dev/null; grep -rl "PageProps<\|RouteContext<\|LayoutProps<" . | head; grep -n "global-not-found\|forbidden" -r 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/ -l | head

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; grep -n -B2 -A12 "PageProps<" 03-file-conventions/page.md | head -50; grep -n -A10 "RouteContext<" 03-file-conventions/route.md | head -30; ls 03-file-conventions
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n "reset\|unstable_retry\|interface\|Props\|'use client'" 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | head -40; ls 02-guides | grep -i cach

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n "global-error" -r 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | head -3; sed -n '/## Global Error/,/^## [A-Z]/p' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | head -60; grep -n "global-not-found\|globalNotFound" -r . -l | head
cd /workspace; cat .gitignore; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50; grep -n -i "metadata" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head
mkdir -p app/blog/\[id\] app/api/posts/\[id\] lib && git rm -rq pages components/AppProvider.js && ls

printf '.next/
next-env.d.ts
*.tsbuildinfo
' >> .gitignore && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40 && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
u=http://localhost:3123
for p in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/50 /blog/9999 /nope; do echo "$p -> $(curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code}' $u$p) | $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/out.html | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ') $(grep -o '<meta property="og:title"[^>]*>' /tmp/out.html)"; done
grep -o 'user agent: [^<]*\|font-family[^;]*' /tmp/out.html | head -2; curl -s $u/ | grep -o 'Your user agent: <!-- -->[^<]*'
curl -s $u/api/posts; echo; curl -s -XPOST $u/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"a"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n'
curl -s -XPOST $u/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"a","content":"b"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n'
curl -s $u/api/posts/7; echo; curl -s -XPUT $u/api/posts/7 -d '{"title":"t"}' -H 'content-type: application/json'; echo; curl -s -XDELETE $u/api/posts/7; echo
curl -s -i -XPATCH $u/api/posts/7 | grep -i 'HTTP/\|^allow'; curl -s -i -XDELETE $u/api/posts | grep -i 'HTTP/\|^allow'
pkill -f "next start" ; cat /tmp/next.log | tail -5

npx next build 2>&1 | grep -i "error\|warn\|✓ Compiled"; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|<link rel="icon"[^>]*>\|<meta name="description"[^>]*>'; curl -s localhost:3123/blog | grep -o '<html[^>]*>'; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short; cat tsconfig.json | grep include
